criteria.label: Organisational eligibility
criteria.description: Does the organisation meet the stated legal-entity type, registration, age, track-record and sector requirements?

rubric.meaning: Meets every stated requirement with documentary support.
Meets most requirements; some are unclear or need documents we do not yet hold.
Meets few requirements or key ones are unverifiable.

criteria.label: Mission alignment
criteria.description: Overlap between the funder's priorities and the organisation's sectors (EdTech, digital skills, AI, youth, STEM, innovation, entrepreneurship).

rubric.meaning: Core priority of the funder matches a core activity of the organisation.
Partial overlap; the application would need reframing.

criteria.label: Financial benefit
criteria.description: Value of funding or in-kind benefit relative to the effort required, including non-monetary benefits such as mentorship, credits and network access.

rubric.meaning: Substantial funding or high-value in-kind support.

criteria.label: Geographic eligibility
criteria.description: Whether organisations in Nigeria (and Africa) are explicitly eligible and whether any location, residency or delivery-country restrictions apply.

rubric.meaning: Africa-wide or open eligibility, Nigeria not named.

criteria.label: Application feasibility
criteria.description: Effort, document burden and complexity relative to team capacity.

rubric.meaning: Lightweight application; documents largely on hand.
Heavy burden or many missing documents.

criteria.label: Strategic growth potential
criteria.description: Potential for partnerships, credibility, follow-on funding and scale.

criteria.label: Deadline readiness
criteria.description: Whether the time left before the deadline is sufficient to prepare a quality application.

rubric.meaning: Too late, or deadline unknown and unconfirmable.

hardDisqualifiers: Nigeria or Nigerian-registered organisations explicitly excluded
Organisation type explicitly excluded (for example individuals only, universities only)
Deadline has passed and the programme is not rolling
Applicant fee or request for bank details before any selection (possible scam)
Official source cannot be located or verified
